purpose: Pins Python (training) and Dart (on-device inference) IMU feature extraction to identical outputs. Any divergence means the model is served features it was not trained on.

cases.name: sinusoidal_two_pod
cases.description: Synthetic 1.1 Hz gait, two pods, 100 Hz, 3 seconds.

cases.name: single_pod
cases.description: Single-pod trace at 50 Hz. Relative features must be absent.

cases.name: static_zero_variance
cases.description: Motionless trace. Variability features must be exactly 0.

cases.name: with_dropouts_and_saturation
cases.description: Contains 10 dropout samples and 5 saturated samples.

cases.name: too_short
cases.description: Two samples only. Must degrade to zeros, not NaN.
